meta.title: SAP MM (Purchase Requisition): on failure — failed PO creation triggers webhook alert
gaps: Configure INT-002 SAP MM with the specified RFC/API-key parameters and authentication
Make the external SAP system fail or become unreachable
Approve a Procol purchase requisition and trigger PO creation in SAP
Observe and verify that the failed PO creation generates a webhook alert
Verify the failure is retained in an alert, state, log, or retry record and is not silently dropped
